method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: One panorama about 7.5 m from the front, resected on the house's east corner (heading 152) and its joint with the pass 77 block (heading 202); the two headings agree on all window axes within 0.2 m and the base row lies at 0 with a camera 2.3 m high. The dormer was brought forward after the first comparison hid it behind the cornice. The roof and the yard side are estimates.
